identity_semantics: New Hugging Face tree oid compared with historical blob_id. These are object identities, not SHA-256 labels. Historical lfs_sha256 is retained in the accepted inventory but the current non-expanded tree response did not provide LFS SHA-256.
interpretation: Matching file object identity is file-level evidence only and is not an automatic simulation duplicate or exclusion.
limitations: Zero historical matches is not a non-overlap finding because the accepted historical inventory contains no archive identities.
Current tree oid values are retained as object identities and are not represented as SHA-256.
